title: Americans aged 100 and older

source.name: Decennial Census centenarian counts and Census Bureau population estimates

notes: 1990 and 2010 are decennial Census counts; 2020 reflects the Census Bureau's reported ~50% growth over the 2010 count; 2024 is the Census Bureau's current population estimate as widely reported (Pew Research, CNBC) in early 2024/2025 coverage.
